basic_profile.bio: Living in the heart of Chicago, I work as a freelance graphic designer. My love for TV shows like Chicago Fire and animated series like Craig of the Creek keeps me glued to the screen. When I'm not designing, I enjoy exploring the Hudson Valley for its scenic beauty. Relationship-wise, I'm single and enjoy the freedom it brings to explore my hobbies and interests. I'm often online during late-night hours, which is when my creative juices flow best. I have a penchant for dark humor and enjoy discussing less mainstream topics.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having pursued a degree in graphic design, my expertise lies in visual arts and digital creativity. My knowledge is a mix of formal education and hands-on experience through freelance projects and collaborations.
